newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TRIUMPHS IN FRENCH 500CC GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TRIUMPHS IN FRENCH 500CC GRAND PRIX.

text.p: Australia's Michael Doohan, riding a Honda, stormed to victory in the 500cc French motorcycling Grand Prix on Sunday, notching up his fifth win out of six races this season.
Spain's Carlos Checa came in second and Japan's Tadayuki Okada was third.
The Australian, who is the reigning world champion, also won in Malaysia, Japan, Italy and Austria, losing only the Spanish Grand Prix to Honda teammate Alex Criville of Spain.
The win, Doohan's second consecutive victory at Le Castellet, allows him to break away at the top of the provisional championship standings.

Japan's Tetsuya Harada, riding an Aprilia, won the 250cc race ahead of Italian world champion Max Biaggi. Local favourite Olivier Jacque, who started in the pole position, was forced out of the race in the first lap.
